page.title: Bookings
page.description: Bookings reserve seats on tour departures for this agency's customers.
page.noBookings: This agency has no bookings yet.

error.loadFailed: We could not load the bookings.

create.title: New booking
create.description: Pick a customer, tour and departure. Amounts are computed by the server from the departure's stored prices.
create.customerEmpty: This agency has no active customers to book for.
create.tourEmpty: This agency has no bookable tours.
create.departureEmpty: This tour has no open departures.
create.pricingHint: Choose a departure to see its stored add-on prices.
create.pricingEmpty: This departure has no stored prices yet. The booking will start with a zero total.
create.totalNote: Preview only — the server computes and records the final total.

cancel.title: Cancel this booking?
cancel.description: Cancelling releases the reserved seats back to the departure. It is a one-way action: there is no restore.

details.notFound: This booking does not exist in this agency.
details.priceLinesEmpty: No add-ons were selected; the total is zero.
details.pendingHint: This booking stays pending until its traveler list matches the reserved seats; confirming is only possible with one traveler per seat.

travelers.title: Travelers
travelers.frozenHint: This booking is no longer pending, so its traveler list is frozen.

validation.nameMax: Names must be 100 characters or fewer.
validation.phoneMax: Phone must be 32 characters or fewer.
validation.notesMax: Notes must be 2000 characters or fewer.

confirm.title: Confirm this booking?
confirm.description: Confirmation records the current traveler list as the booking's ticket manifest. It is a one-way action: there is no going back to pending.
confirm.ready: The traveler manifest matches the reserved seats — this booking is ready to confirm.
confirm.notReady: The traveler manifest does not yet match the reserved seats; add or edit travelers before confirming.

validation.reservedSeats: Seats must be a positive whole number.
validation.pricingDuplicate: An add-on can only be selected once.
validation.notesMax: Notes must be 2000 characters or fewer.
validation.reasonMax: Reason must be 500 characters or fewer.
